title: Badges contract
description:
Language-neutral badge shapes shared by iOS, Android, backend, and admin. awardedBadge mirrors the Firestore `users/{uid}/badges/{badgeKey}` document (document ID = badge key; catalog definition denormalized). The catalog itself lives in functions/src/badges/badge-core.ts (single source of truth, ported from the legacy badge-catalog): wording stays positive and non-competitive, no badge rewards speed, all user-facing text in Swedish. Badges are backend-awarded only and never revoked. Firestore stores timestamps as native Timestamp values; this contract describes their ISO 8601 JSON serialization.

TIERED LADDERS: alongside the five original flat achievements there are six tiered ladders — Kronjägare (crowns collected), Vägfarare (lifetime distance driven), Träffräv (events attended), Trogen (best consecutive-day app-open streak), Konvojledare (convoys led), Samlare (cars in garage). Each TIER IS ITS OWN badge key so a member can display the exact tier reached. The ladders are MONOTONIC: earning a higher tier never removes a lower one, and a member's badges are a permanent display collection, not a current rank. Tiers are awarded exclusively by Firestore triggers from server-verified counters (functions/src/badges/progressTriggers.ts) — never by a callable and never from a client-reported number — and each first award also credits Kronpoäng (25/75/200/500 for brons/silver/guld/platina) through the points ledger with a deterministic idempotency key.

badgeTier.description: Ladder rung. One ladder stops at guld: Trogen, because a 365-day-streak rung is ruled out on wellbeing grounds (docs/gamification-system.md Q6 and §9). Samlare gained its platina rung when the garage cap rose to ten vehicles, making the top rung reachable.

badgeLadder.description: Tiered ladder a badge is a rung of. Null on the five standalone badges.

badgeKey.description: Canonical badge keys. The first five are FROZEN — members already hold documents at those IDs, so a key is never renamed or remapped. helpful_member is the only manually awardable key; every other key is awarded automatically by the backend. garage_created is HISTORIC: it is still awarded on the first vehicle and is superseded for new design work by samlare_brons, which measures the same moment as the bottom rung of the Samlare ladder — both are kept so existing holders are untouched, and garage_created carries no points so holding both is not a double payout.

awardedBadge.description: Firestore `users/{uid}/badges/{badgeKey}`. Owner-only read; backend-only writes; never revoked.

iconIdentifier.description: Opaque icon reference for the client UI (badge_{badgeKey}).

ladder.description: Ladder this badge is a rung of; null for the five standalone badges. OPTIONAL: badge documents awarded before the ladders shipped do not carry this field, and are not back-filled (a rewrite would move awardedAt). Clients must treat an absent value as null.

tier.description: Rung on `ladder`; null for the standalone badges. OPTIONAL for the same reason as `ladder`.

awardedByUserId.description: Awarding admin UID for admin_manual awards; null for automatic.

awardHelpfulMemberRequest.description: Input for badges.awardHelpfulMember (admin-only). The reason is required and lands in the adminAuditEvents record, never on the badge document.
